 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Champions League returns with Matchday 4 of the League Phase: Inter need to bounce back from their derby defeat and have the chance to do so against Feyenoord , a tricky fixture at De Kuip in Rotterdam (where Como were beaten 3-2).
 Roma , meanwhile, are unbeaten since Matchday 2 of the Champions League, when they lost to Real Madrid in the closing minutes. Tonight, the Giallorossi face Manchester United at Old Trafford: a tough away trip despite the Red Devils ' disastrous form.
 Feyenoord-Inter
 FEYENOORD (4-3-3) : Ernst; Read, Kraaijeveld, Marmol, Javi Lopez; Zechiel, Vanhoutte, Targhelline; Hadj Moussa, Ferri, Valente. Coach : Van Bronckhorst
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement INTER (3-5-2) : Martinez; Bisseck, Akanji, Carlos Augusto; Spence, Barella, Calhanoglu, Zielinski, Dimarco; Thuram, Esposito. Coach : Chivu
 Manchester United-Roma
 MAN UNITED (4-2-3-1) : Lammens; Yoro, Maguire, Heaven, Dalot; Mainoo, Baleba; Cunha, Diallo, Bruno Fernandes; Mbeumo. Coach : Carrick
 ROMA (3-4-2-1) : Vasquez; Mancini, Balerdi, Hermoso; Rensch, Cristante, De Roon, Wesley; Soulé, Mora; Malen. Coach : Gasperini
 Gollini is unavailable for Roma due to a back problem.
